info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Loan Management API
info.description: The Corporate Loan Management API enables organizations to efficiently update existing corporate loan details. This API allows authorized users to modify parameters such as interest rates, loan amounts, and payment schedules for current loans. Typical consumers include bank staff and financial institutions that manage corporate lending portfolios, optimizing loan performance and compliance with the latest regulations. Enhanced functionality through this API fosters better customer service and streamlined financial operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific corporate loan identified by its unique loan ID. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary fields that need to be modified.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific corporate loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that the JSON payload adheres to the defined schema for proper processing.
